title: Engineering and Integrity Learnings: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: Seals bought without a specification entered service with no technical approval.

items.lesson: A part without a specification is an unreviewed design change.
items.explanation: Seals were bought locally without a specification from March 2022 [FND-0003; EVD-0003].

items.failure_mode: No approval step existed for local purchases
items.fix: Block critical-spares orders without a specification in the purchasing system
items.indicator: % of critical-spares orders with a specification reference

items.change: Route every substitute part through change control

items.decision: Which leak test applies after a seal change, and at what pressure?
options: Set by the technical authority per pump class

items.text: Each critical spare's record names its specification and approver.
